review.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed but playable; 7 good with meaningful friction; 9 excellent with little observed friction; 10 exceptional. Subjective holistic assessment of observed emulated mobile play only, not an average of stats or win/loss.
review.overallReason: Both complete runs were understandable and rewarding in their clear objective/progress feedback. Strong atmosphere, large primary touch buttons and contextual route/recovery assistance make the mission approachable. Manual patrol touch engagement was feasible, but acquisition at the right control edge failed, distant threats were small, and close coil geometry complicated identification. Heavy assisted routing and paused observation limit confidence about sustained mobile play. Wins do not independently determine this grade.
review.controlsReason: MOVE plus FIRE drag, scene swipes, tap aim, DASH, map close, and START FRESH worked visibly. One right-edge target attempt failed without turn/down; continuous held rearming, unassisted precision, physical thumb comfort, ZOOM, JUMP and TOOLS remain unassessed. DASH activation observed, defensive success not established.
review.gameplayReason: Recoveries, coil phases, reloads and uplink provide a readable sequence with some tension from shield loss. Assisted route completion involved little navigation decision-making; two short runs do not establish sustained depth or enjoyment.
review.presentationReason: Cohesive rain, teal/orange lighting, industrial geometry and restrained result card support the rescue mood. Some silhouettes and foreground structures look coarse in software WebGL; performance/artifact causes cannot be assigned. Audio not assessed.
review.usabilityReason: Contextual HOLD ROUTE/APPROACH/RECOVER instructions, named destinations, map route and fresh-start result button are helpful. Map overview is small and UI covers substantial scene area in landscape. No settings changed; broader settings usability unassessed.
review.readabilityReason: Health/ammo and objective progress are legible; explicit coil percentages/OFF and upload percentage support recovery from mistakes. Small patrols, muted contrast, tiny world labels, overlapping prompts/control areas and close coil supports complicate scene reading.
helpfulMoments: Opening instruction immediately explained tap aim, FIRE, swipe and DASH.
